flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/HST/revival/{HSTRevival,form/HSTRevivalForm} + hooks/useHST.tsx (Revive HST); ocmsadminapi HstManagementController (POST /v1/revive-hst) and HstManagementServiceImpl.reviveHst/updateMailingAddress; api-authorization.properties OCMS_HST_REVIVAL. No work item screen
note: Story status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. The 'lift indicator' decision can be done through the HST Revival page (confirmation dialog, revive all TS-HST, delete the ocms_hst row, save the new address as furnished_mail). Gap: there is no work item to review (the OIC types the ID and sees the old address), no recorded 'keep' path, no separate 'resend reminder' choice (only implied by revive; the daily letter generation is commented out, ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118, manual trigger only), and officerAuthorisingRevival is filled with the system user so the OIC identity is not recorded in suspended_notice (HstManagementServiceImpl.java:529, GAP-011). The actual resending of the reminder is OCMS20.26. Relevant maintenance tickets: none changes a verdict (OCMS-DF-2026-093 and -117 concern the furnish and looping paths, not this screen). The actual access roles cannot verify from repo (only the OCMS_HST_REVIVAL mapping).
recommendation: Claim partially (~50%): the lift action plus confirmation exist. Do not claim work item review, recording of a 'keep' decision, or a separate resend-reminder choice.

steps.step: The OIC opens and reviews the work item (existing address vs new address)
steps.detail: There is no HST work item screen. The staff UI has no HST work item concept; the only work item there is 'UPL Endorsement' (ocmsadminui/src/utils/constant.ts:300-303). What exists: after the OIC types an ID on the Revival page, check-hst in revival mode returns the name and address from ocms_hst, i.e. the OLD address (HstManagementServiceImpl.java:157-164), not the new one; the new address is typed manually in the form (HSTRevivalForm.tsx:153-229).

steps.step: The OIC states the decision: lift the indicator or keep it
steps.detail: The 'lift' path exists: the 'Revive HST' button (HSTRevivalForm.tsx:252-254) -> onRevive (:52) -> POST revive-hst (useHST.tsx:139) -> reviveHst (HstManagementServiceImpl.java:419-466): revives all TS-HST of the ID (reviveHstSuspension, revival reason 'HAV', remarks 'HST Revival - New address obtained', :528-530) and then deletes the ocms_hst row (:466). Authorization comes from the OCMS_HST_REVIVAL mapping (api-authorization.properties:102-103). Gap: the 'keep' path has no action or record (the OIC simply does not press the button), the decision is not attached to a work item, and officerAuthorisingRevival is filled with DEFAULT_SYSTEM_USER_ID, not the OIC user (HstManagementServiceImpl.java:529, marked GAP-011), so who decided is not recorded in suspended_notice. The remarks always say 'New address obtained' even though no new address is validated.

steps.step: The OIC states the decision to resend the reminder to the new/alternative address
steps.detail: There is no 'resend reminder' option in the form. Revive writes the form address to the furnished_mail address record and marks it letter_address='Y' (updateMailingAddress, HstManagementServiceImpl.java:572-614, called from :455), so the next letter goes to the new address, and the screen says 'notices will resume processing' (HSTRevivalForm.tsx:126). The reminder is only actually sent if the Toppan pipeline runs; the daily letter generator call is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118) and only runs through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters. Explicit resending is the scope of OCMS20.26 and is not checked here; this story only asks for the decision to be stated, and that decision is implied only by pressing Revive.

Before execution the OIC sees the dialog 'Are you sure you want to revive HST for <ID>? This will delete the HST ID and revive all TS-HST suspensions' (HSTRevivalForm.tsx:73); after success a modal shows the server message or 'HST revived successfully.' (:94-106). This confirms the lift decision only; there is no confirmation for a 'keep' decision because there is no action for it (see the decision step).
